data.revised_prompt: Create a polished monochrome visual for a graduation defense PPT cover, designed for an NFT digital collectibles trading platform. Centered square composition with generous negative space around the subject, suitable for placement on the right side of a title slide. Show a premium 3D digital token as the focal object, surrounded by subtle blockchain node connections, a few IPFS-like distributed storage cubes, and a clean abstract marketplace interface impression in the background. Modern academic technology presentation style, grayscale palette with restrained highlights, clean studio lighting, professional, elegant, not flashy. Crisp 3D render, minimal but refined details, high-end product visualization. No text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no logo. Avoid neon colors, busy details, cartoon style, crypto coin logos, brand logos.
